TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is scheduled for October 13-15 at Moscone West in San Francisco.

The event focuses on building companies in the AI era with over 200 expert sessions across six curated stages, including the Disrupt, Builders, AI, Real World AI, Smart Money, and Smart Systems stages.

Featured speakers include leaders from Rivian, Amazon, Tether, Bluesky, Replit, and Cerebras.
